2.264.21
MapViewport.Style
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapViewport.Style element specifies style information for a MapViewport element. The
MapViewport.Style element is optional and is of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the MapViewport.Style element.
Parent elements
MapViewport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapViewport.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
